sEn: Gemma 4 introduces a new generation of open-weight multimodal language models with significant improvements in efficiency, reasoning, and multimodal capabilities, rivaling larger frontier models.
sZh: Gemma 4 是新一代开源重量级多模态语言模型，在效率、推理和多模态能力上显著提升，可与更大规模的先进模型媲美。
absEn: We introduce Gemma 4, a new generation of open-weight, natively multimodal language models in the Gemma model family. Designed to advance compute efficiency and reasoning, the Gemma 4 model suite features dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, ranging from 2.3B to 31B parameters. Alongside improved vision and audio encoders for all model sizes, we propose a unified, encoder-free architecture for our 12B model, which ingests raw audio and image patches. Furthermore, we integrate a thinking mode, enabling Gemma models to generate reasoning traces prior to responding. We improve inference speed, memory, and compute efficiency, as well as long-context abilities through critical design choices. Gemma 4 establishes a leap in performance across STEM, multimodal, and long-context benchmarks, and rivals larger, frontier open models in human-rated tasks.
absZh: 我们推出了 Gemma 4，这是 Gemma 模型家族中新一代开源权重、原生多模态语言模型。为了提升计算效率和推理能力，Gemma 4 模型系列采用了密集和混合专家架构，参数量从 2.3B 到 31B 不等。除了为所有模型尺寸改进了视觉和音频编码器之外，我们还为 12B 模型提出了一种统一的、无编码器的架构，该架构直接处理原始音频和图像块。此外，我们集成了一种思考模式，使 Gemma 模型能够在响应之前生成推理轨迹。我们通过关键设计选择提高了推理速度、内存和计算效率以及长上下文能力。Gemma 4 在 STEM、多模态和长上下文基准测试中取得了性能飞跃，并在人工评估任务中与更大规模的前沿开源模型相媲美。

contrib.en: Introduces Gemma 4 with open-weight natively multimodal models and dense/MoE architectures up to 31B parameters.
contrib.zh: 提出了Gemma 4，包含开放权重的原生多模态模型，采用稠密和MoE架构，参数规模高达31B。

contrib.en: Integrates a thinking mode that generates reasoning traces before responding, improving performance on math and code.
contrib.zh: 集成了思考模式，在响应前生成推理轨迹，提升了数学和代码任务上的性能。

contrib.en: Proposes a unified encoder-free architecture for the 12B model, processing raw audio patches and image patches directly.
contrib.zh: 为12B模型提出了统一的免编码器架构，直接处理原始音频片段和图像块。

contrib.en: Enhances long-context efficiency via local-to-global attention ratios, KV cache sharing, and p-RoPE.
contrib.zh: 通过局部-全局注意力比例、KV缓存共享和p-RoPE提升了长上下文效率。

contrib.en: Improves compute and memory efficiency with multi-token prediction drafters and quantization-aware training.
contrib.zh: 通过多词元预测草稿器和量化感知训练提升了计算和内存效率。

contrib.en: Achieves performance rivaling larger frontier open models on human-rated tasks, with a leap over Gemma 3.
contrib.zh: 在人工评分的任务上达到与更大规模前沿开放模型相当的性能，相比Gemma 3有显著飞跃。

limits.en: The encoder-free architecture is only applied to the 12B model, not generalized to other sizes.
limits.zh: 免编码器架构仅应用于12B模型，未推广到其他尺寸。

limits.en: Thinking mode increases response latency, which may hinder real-time applications.
limits.zh: 思考模式增加了响应延迟，可能阻碍实时应用。

limits.en: Models are smaller than the largest frontier models (e.g., GPT-4), potentially limiting performance on some tasks.
limits.zh: 模型比最大的前沿模型（如GPT-4）小，可能限制了某些任务的性能。

limits.en: Safety evaluations are based on internal testing; independent validation remains needed.
limits.zh: 安全评估基于内部测试，仍需独立验证。

limits.en: The MoE variant may encounter load balancing challenges during training and inference.
limits.zh: MoE变体在训练和推理中可能遇到负载均衡挑战。

items.zh: 完整作者列表请见贡献与致谢部分。请将信件发送至 gemma4report@gmail.com。

items.en: We introduce Gemma 4, a new generation of open-weight, natively multimodal language models in the Gemma model family. Designed to advance compute efficiency and reasoning, the Gemma 4 model suite features dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, ranging from 2.3B to 31B parameters. Alongside improved vision and audio encoders for all model sizes, we propose a unified, encoder-free architecture for our 12B model, which ingests raw audio and image patches. Furthermore, we integrate a thinking mode, enabling Gemma models to generate reasoning traces prior to responding. We improve inference speed, memory, and compute efficiency, as well as long-context abilities through critical design choices. Gemma 4 establishes a leap in performance across STEM, multimodal, and long-context benchmarks, and rivals larger, frontier open models in human-rated tasks.
items.zh: 我们推出Gemma 4，这是Gemma模型家族中新一代的开源权重、原生多模态语言模型。为提升算力效率和推理能力，Gemma 4模型套件包含密集架构和混合专家架构，参数量从2.3B到31B不等。除了对所有模型尺寸改进视觉和音频编码器外，我们还为12B模型提出统一的、无编码器架构，可直接处理原始音频和图像块。此外，我们集成了思考模式，使Gemma模型能够在响应前生成推理轨迹。我们通过关键设计选择提升了推理速度、内存和算力效率以及长上下文能力。Gemma 4在STEM、多模态和长上下文基准测试中实现了性能飞跃，在人工评定的任务上与更大规模的前沿开放模型相抗衡。

items.en: The rapid evolution of large language models has driven the need for open-weight models with strong multimodal understanding, reasoning, and computational efficiency. Building upon the foundations of its predecessors, we introduce Gemma 4, the most capable and efficient generation in the Gemma model family to date. Gemma 4 offers natively multimodal architectures, capable of seamlessly processing text, images, and audio while achieving frontier-level performance on highly complex reasoning tasks. The Gemma 4 family is built to serve a variety of on-device hardware. The model suite includes both dense architectures (2.3B, 4.5B, 12B, and 31B parameters) and a Mixture-of-Experts variant with 3.8B activated and 26B total parameters. We introduce several architectural and methodological innovations:
items.zh: 大型语言模型的快速发展推动了对具有强多模态理解、推理和计算效率的开源权重模型的需求。在先前模型的基础上，我们推出Gemma 4，这是迄今为止Gemma模型家族中最强大且最高效的一代。Gemma 4提供原生多模态架构，能够无缝处理文本、图像和音频，同时在高度复杂的推理任务上达到前沿性能。Gemma 4系列旨在服务于各种设备端硬件。该模型套件包括密集架构（2.3B、4.5B、12B和31B参数）以及一个混合专家（MoE）变体，激活参数3.8B，总参数26B。我们引入了若干架构和方法创新：

items.en: Thinking mode for advanced reasoning: We introduce a thinking mode to Gemma 4 models. By outputting a reasoning trace before the response, models demonstrate improved capabilities in reasoning-heavy domains such as mathematics and coding.
items.zh: 高级推理的思考模式：我们为Gemma 4模型引入了思考模式。通过在回答前输出推理轨迹，模型在数学和编程等推理密集型领域显示出改进的能力。

items.en: Long-context efficiency: Extended contexts lead to a memory explosion in the KV cache. We conserve a 5:1 ratio of local sliding window to global self-attention (4:1 for the 2.3B model) and use \(p\)-RoPE as positional encoding. Combined with KV cache sharing and the reuse of keys as values in global layers, these optimizations reduce the global KV cache footprint by up to 37.5%.
items.zh: 长上下文效率：扩展上下文会导致KV缓存内存爆炸。我们采用5:1的局部滑动窗口与全局自注意力比例（2.3B模型为4:1），并使用\(p\)-RoPE作为位置编码。结合KV缓存共享和全局层中键值重用，这些优化将全局KV缓存占用最多减少37.5%。

items.en: Compute efficiency: We release an autoregressive multi-token prediction (MTP) drafter head designed for speculative decoding to improve the decoding speed of our models.
items.zh: 计算效率：我们发布了一个自回归多词元预测（MTP）草案头，用于推测解码，以提高模型的解码速度。

items.en: Memory efficiency: We provide quantized versions of our models trained with quantization-aware training to reduce their parameter memory footprint and latency with minimal impact on quality.
items.zh: 内存效率：我们提供了经过量化感知训练训练的模型量化版本，以减少参数内存占用和延迟，同时对质量影响最小。

items.en: Encoder-free architecture: Gemma 4 models have frozen vision and audio encoders. We introduce a unified encoder-free architecture for the 12B model, which projects raw 40ms audio chunks and image patches into the LLM embedding space, alleviating the need for separate encoders and reducing memory fragmentation.
items.zh: 免编码器架构：Gemma 4 模型拥有冻结的视觉和音频编码器。我们为 12B 模型引入了一种统一的免编码器架构，它将原始 40ms 音频块和图像块投影到大语言模型嵌入空间，消除了对独立编码器的需求，并减少了内存碎片。

items.en: In this technical report, we outline the different model architectures across model sizes as well as the pre-training and post-training recipe of Gemma 4. Through comprehensive benchmarks and human evaluations such as Arena, we demonstrate that Gemma 4 operates at a level comparable to larger, frontier open-source models across text, image, and audio modalities. We release the Gemma 4 models under an Apache 2.0 license, empowering developers and researchers everywhere to build upon, customize, and extend these capabilities.
items.zh: 在本技术报告中，我们概述了不同模型规模的架构以及 Gemma 4 的预训练和后训练方案。通过全面的基准测试和 Arena 等人工评估，我们证明 Gemma 4 在文本、图像和音频模态上的表现可与更大的前沿开源模型相媲美。我们在 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布 Gemma 4 模型，赋能全球开发者和研究人员基于这些能力进行构建、定制和扩展。

items.en: Gemma 4 models follow a decoder-only Transformer architecture. Our models have pre-norm and post-norm with RMSNorm and QKNorm.
items.zh: Gemma 4模型采用仅解码器Transformer架构。我们的模型使用RMSNorm进行前归一化和后归一化，并使用了QKNorm。

items.en: Dense and MoE: The Gemma 4 family of models comprises dense architectures, with effective 2.3B (E2B), effective 4.5B (E4B), 12B and 31B parameters, as well as an MoE model with 3.8B activated parameters for 26B total parameters (26B-A4B). E2B and E4B use per-layer embeddings as in Gemma 3n, making them 2.3B and 4.5B effective out of 5B and 8B total parameters respectively.
items.zh: 密集与MoE：Gemma 4模型系列包含密集架构，有效参数分别为2.3B（E2B）、4.5B（E4B）、12B和31B，以及一个MoE模型，该模型激活参数为3.8B，总参数为26B（26B-A4B）。E2B和E4B采用逐层嵌入（如同Gemma 3n），使其在总参数分别为5B和8B的情况下，有效参数分别达到2.3B和4.5B。

items.en: Long-context efficiency: Our local to global attention ratio patterns follow, that is, 4-to-1 local attention blocks for E2B and 5-to-1 for the rest. We improve memory efficiency by re-using keys as values in the global attention layers (except in E2B and E4B), i.e., \(\text{values}=\text{keys}\). We encode position with \(p\)-RoPE with \(p=0.25\) on global attention layers and with RoPE on local attention layers, effectively reducing the global KV cache by 37.5%. The RoPE frequencies are set to 1M and 10k on global and local attention layers, respectively. Finally, we share the KV cache with ratios of 20/35 and 18/42 for the E2B and E4B model.
items.zh: 长上下文效率：我们的局部与全局注意力比例模式遵循以下规则：E2B使用4:1的局部注意力块，其余模型使用5:1。我们通过在全局注意力层（E2B和E4B除外）中重用键作为值来提升内存效率，即\(\text{values}=\text{keys}\)。我们在全局注意力层采用p-RoPE（其中\(p=0.25\)），在局部注意力层采用RoPE，有效减少了37.5%的全局KV缓存。全局和局部注意力层的RoPE频率分别设置为1M和10k。最后，E2B和E4B模型分别以20/35和18/42的比例共享KV缓存。

items.en: E2B and E4B Gemma models come with a 150M vision encoder, while larger models use a 550M encoder (except for the unified 12B). Both are Vision Transformers with a patch size of 16, whose architectural differences are detailed in Table 10 in Appendix. Our vision encoders support variable aspect ratios (see Figure 2 and Algorithm 1) and incorporate both axial 2D-RoPE with non-causal attention and 2D absolute positional embeddings. We restrict the maximum number of tokens, \(N_{\text{max}}\) to the values \(70,140,280,560\) and \(1120\) (see Algorithm 1 for implementation details).
items.zh: E2B 和 E4B 的 Gemma 模型配备 1.5 亿参数的视觉编码器，而更大的模型则使用 5.5 亿参数的编码器（统一的 12B 模型除外）。两者都是 Vision Transformers，patch size 为 16，其架构差异详见附录中的表 10。我们的视觉编码器支持可变长宽比（见图 2 和算法 1），并且同时采用了基于非因果注意力机制的轴向 2D-RoPE 和 2D 绝对位置嵌入。我们将最大 token 数 \(N_{\text{max}}\) 限制为 \(70,140,280,560\) 和 \(1120\)（实现细节见算法 1）。

items.en: E2B and E4B Gemma models use a 305M audio encoder that processes audio in 40 ms chunks with Mel filterbank inputs. The encoder architecture is based on the Universal Speech Model, consisting of two downsampling convolution layers followed by twelve Conformer layers. While the architecture remains similar to that of Gemma 3n, we reduce the number of parameters by 55% (from 680M to 305M). We do not use vector quantization; the LLM ingests the continuous representations produced by the audio encoder. As with the vision encoder, we keep weights frozen during pre-training.
items.zh: E2B和E4B Gemma模型使用一个305M的音频编码器，该编码器以40毫秒的块处理音频，输入为梅尔滤波器组特征。编码器架构基于通用语音模型（Universal Speech Model），由两个下采样卷积层和十二个Conformer层组成。虽然架构与Gemma 3n相似，但我们将其参数量减少了55%（从680M降至305M）。我们不使用向量量化；大语言模型直接接收音频编码器产生的连续表示。与视觉编码器类似，我们在预训练期间保持其权重冻结。

items.en: Gemma 4 12B is trained from scratch based on a new, unified, and encoder-free model paradigm, replacing the separate vision and audio encoders with lightweight projection modules. For the vision modality, Gemma 4 12B takes in \(48 \times 48 \times 3\) RGB patches, but replaces the 550M vision encoder with a single large matmul (35M parameters). Spatial awareness is maintained by adding 2D coordinate-based positional embeddings directly to the patch representations before a final LayerNorm layer.
items.zh: Gemma 4 12B 从头开始训练，基于一种新的、统一的、无编码器模型范式，用轻量级投影模块取代了独立的视觉和音频编码器。对于视觉模态，Gemma 4 12B 输入 \(48 \times 48 \times 3\) RGB 块，但用一个大型矩阵乘法（35M 参数）取代了 550M 的视觉编码器。通过在最终 LayerNorm 层之前直接将基于 2D 坐标的位置嵌入添加到块表示中，来保持空间感知能力。

items.en: For audio, the 305M USM-based conformer encoder is entirely discarded. Raw audio is segmented into 40ms chunks at 16kHz, resulting in 640-dimensional vectors per chunk. These are projected directly into the LLM embedding space. Since audio is a temporal sequence, it does not require additional positional encoding.
items.zh: 对于音频，完全抛弃了基于 USM 的 305M Conformer 编码器。原始音频被分割为 40ms 的块（16kHz 采样），每个块产生 640 维向量。这些向量被直接投影到 LLM 嵌入空间中。由于音频是时间序列，它不需要额外的位置编码。

items.en: We follow a similar pre-training as Gemma 3.
items.zh: 我们采用与 Gemma 3 类似的预训练方式。

items.en: Training data. Our pre-training dataset is a large-scale, diverse collection of data from a wide range of domains and modalities, including web documents, code, images, and audio (for E2B, E4B and 12B), with a cutoff date of January 2025.
items.zh: 训练数据。我们的预训练数据集是一个大规模、多样化的数据集合，涵盖广泛的领域和模态，包括网页文档、代码、图像和音频（针对 E2B、E4B 和 12B），截止日期为 2025 年 1 月。

items.capEn: Figure 1: The autoregressive MTP drafter (blue blocks on the right) is fed activations and KV cache from the main model (gray blocks).

items.en: Tokenizer. We use the same tokenizer as that of Gemma 3, a SentencePiece tokenizer with split digits, preserved whitespace, and byte-level encodings. The vocabulary has 262k entries.
items.zh: 分词器。我们使用与 Gemma 3 相同的分词器，即 SentencePiece 分词器，具有拆分数字、保留空白和字节级编码。词汇表有 262k 个条目。

items.en: Filtering. We filter data to decontaminate benchmarks, and to reduce the risk of unwanted or unsafe utterances and the risk of recitation.
items.zh: 过滤。我们对数据进行过滤，以消除基准测试污染，并降低出现不良或不当言论以及背诵风险。

items.en: We provide quantized models and encoders in different formats along with the raw checkpoints. Based on the most popular open source quantization inference engines (e.g. llama.cpp) as well as efficient hardware support, we focus on two sets of weight representations:
items.zh: 我们提供不同格式的量化模型和编码器以及原始检查点。基于最流行的开源量化推理引擎（例如 llama.cpp）以及高效的硬件支持，我们关注两组权重表示：

items.en: mobile quantization: per-channel low bitwidth weight (mix of int2 and int4) and activation quantization (int8).
items.zh: 移动端量化：逐通道低位宽权重（混合 int2 和 int4）和激活量化（int8）。

items.en: Q4_0 quantization: blockwise quantization, often referred to as Q4_0.
items.zh: Q4_0 量化：分块量化，通常称为 Q4_0。

items.en: In Table 3, we report the memory filled by raw and quantized models with and without a KV cache for a sequence of 32k tokens. Furthermore, to enable stable inference in fp16, we introduce a scalar scale at each block in order to bound the activation ranges to fit fp16.
items.zh: 在表3中，我们报告了在32k token序列下，有和没有KV缓存时原始模型和量化模型的内存占用。此外，为了实现fp16下的稳定推理，我们在每个块中引入标量尺度，以约束激活范围以适应fp16。

items.en: We also apply QAT to the image and audio encoders. On the 150M image encoder, quantizing activations and weights to 8-bit precision (W8A8) yields a 2 ⟀(⟀times⟀) reduction in total forward-pass memory footprint (from 400 MB to 200 MB, including on-device compilation overhead) and a 44% reduction in on-device latency relative to Gemma 3n on newer hardware. On the audio encoder, we further reduce activation precision to 8 bits and weight precision to ⟀(⟀{2,4,8⟀}⟀) bits, varying by layer cluster. Overall, we achieve a 78% reduction in on-disk footprint, from 390 MB in Gemma 3n to 87 MB in this version.
items.zh: 我们还将 QAT 应用于图像和音频编码器。在 150M 图像编码器上，将激活和权重量化到 8 位精度（W8A8）使得前向传播总内存占用量减少 2 ⟀(⟀times⟀) 倍（从 400 MB 降至 200 MB，包括设备端编译开销），并在较新硬件上相对于 Gemma 3n 将设备端延迟降低 44%。在音频编码器上，我们进一步将激活精度降至 8 位，权重精度按层簇变化降至 ⟀(⟀{2,4,8⟀}⟀) 位。总体而言，我们将磁盘占用减少了 78%，从 Gemma 3n 的 390 MB 降至本版本的 87 MB。

items.en: We train a small autoregressive MTP drafter head with our models, used for speculative decoding. In our MTP procedure, the model’s last layer activations from the previous step and token embeddings are fed into the MTP head. The MTP head generates future tokens sequentially using a separate embedder and a 4-layer Transformer block that cross-attends to the KVs of the main model (Figure 1), thus eliminating the need for MTP prefill and supporting any draft length. The Transformer block has model dimension 256 for E2B and E4B, 1024 for 26B-A4B and 31B, three local, and one global attention layers.
items.zh: 我们使用模型训练一个小型自回归MTP草稿器头，用于推测解码。在我们的MTP过程中，模型上一层的最后一层激活和词元嵌入被输入到MTP头。MTP头使用单独的嵌入器和4层Transformer块顺序生成未来词元，该块交叉注意力到主模型的KV缓存（图1），从而消除了MTP预填充的需要，并支持任意草稿长度。该Transformer块对于E2B和E4B模型维度为256，对于26B-A4B和31B为1024，具有三个局部注意力和一个全局注意力层。

items.en: For the E2B and E4B drafters, we reduce the decoding overhead by replacing the projection operation to the entire vocabulary by a top-k operation on clusters of tokens. As a result, final matrix multiplication is reduced from \(d\times 262,000\) to \(d\times 4096\) while preserving a similar acceptance rate.
items.zh: 对于E2B和E4B起草器，我们通过将针对整个词表的投影操作替换为对token聚类的top-k操作来减少解码开销。因此，最终矩阵乘法从\(d\times 262,000\)减少到\(d\times 4096\)，同时保持相似的接受率。

items.en: We train our models with TPUv4 and TPUv6e as outlined in Table 2. Each model configuration is optimized to minimize training step time. For our larger models, we leverage Slice-Granularity Elasticity, which allows continuous training with fewer “slices” of TPU chips when there is a localized failure. This reconfiguration reduces the delay caused by interruptions from many minutes to a few seconds.
items.zh: 我们使用 TPUv4 和 TPUv6e 训练模型，如表 2 所示。每个模型配置都经过优化以最小化训练步时间。对于较大的模型，我们利用切片粒度弹性（Slice-Granularity Elasticity），当出现局部故障时，允许使用更少的 TPU 芯片“切片”继续训练。这种重新配置将中断造成的延迟从几分钟减少到几秒钟。

items.en: The optimizer state is sharded using an implementation of ZeRO-3. For multi-pod training, we perform a data replica reduction over the data center network, using the Pathways approach. We use the single controller programming paradigm of JAX and Pathways, along with the GSPMD partitioner and the MegaScale XLA compiler.
items.zh: 优化器状态使用 ZeRO-3 的实现进行分片。对于多 Pod 训练，我们使用 Pathways 方法通过数据中心网络执行数据副本归约。我们采用 JAX 和 Pathways 的单控制器编程范式，结合 GSPMD 分区器和 MegaScale XLA 编译器。

items.en: Pre-trained models are turned into instruction-tuned models with a similar post-training approach as in Gemma 3. A significant difference is the addition of a thinking mode, where the model can output a reasoning trace before answering.
items.zh: 预训练模型通过类似 Gemma 3 的后训练方法转变为指令调优模型。一个显著区别是增加了思考模式，模型可以在回答之前输出推理轨迹。

items.en: Data filtering. We carefully optimize the data used in post-training to maximize model performance. We filter examples that show certain personal information, unsafe or toxic model outputs, mistaken self-identification data, and duplicated examples. Including subsets of data that encourage better in-context attribution, hedging, and refusals to minimize hallucinations also improves performance on factuality metrics, without degrading model performance on other metrics.
items.zh: 数据过滤。我们仔细优化后训练中使用的数据，以最大化模型性能。我们过滤掉显示某些个人信息、不安全或有毒模型输出、错误自我识别数据以及重复样本的示例。包含鼓励更好的上下文归因、模糊表述和拒绝回答的子集以最小化幻觉，也能提高事实性指标的性能，而不会降低其他指标上的模型性能。

items.en: PT versus IT formatting. All models share the same tokenizer, with some control tokens dedicated to IT formatting. A key difference is that PT models output an <eos> token at the end of generation, while IT models output <turn|> at the end of the generation. An example is given for IT in Table 11. Fine-tuning either model type thus requires adding their respective end tokens. We detail how to activate thinking and how models handle function calling in Table 11.
items.zh: PT 与 IT 格式化。所有模型共享相同的分词器，并有一些专用于 IT 格式化的控制标记。一个关键区别是 PT 模型在生成结束时输出 <eos> 标记，而 IT 模型在生成结束时输出 <turn|> 标记。表 11 给出了 IT 的示例。因此，微调任一模型类型都需要添加各自对应的结束标记。我们在表 11 中详细说明了如何激活思考以及模型如何处理函数调用。

items.en: In this section, we evaluate the IT models over a series of automated benchmarks and human evaluations across a variety of domains, as well as static benchmarks such as MMLU Pro.
items.zh: 在本节中，我们在多个领域的自动化基准测试和人类评估中评估了IT模型，以及MMLU Pro等静态基准。

items.en: We report the performance of our 31B and 26B-A4B models on Arena in blind side-by-side evaluations by human raters against other state-of-the-art models. We report Elo scores in Table 4. Gemma 4 31B is the top open model in the dense category, and both Gemma 4 31B and 26B-A4B show performance equal to much larger open models.
items.zh: 我们在 Arena 上通过人类评估者的盲测对比评估，报告了我们 31B 和 26B-A4B 模型与其他最先进模型的性能比较。我们在表 4 中报告了 Elo 评分。Gemma 4 31B 是密集类别中表现最佳的开源模型，并且 Gemma 4 31B 和 26B-A4B 均展现出与更大规模开源模型相当的性能。

items.en: In Table 5, we show the performance of our final models across a variety of benchmarks compared to Gemma 3 27B. Gemma 4 31B is closest in size and significantly better across the board, while E2B roughly matches Gemma 3 27B performance with 10x fewer parameters. Table 6 shows the performance of Gemma 4 models on vision benchmarks, with E4B equaling or outperforming Gemma 3 27B on all evals. Tables 7 and 8 display the multilingual audio transcription and translation performance of E2B & E4B and of 12B respectively. Table 9 shows a leap in long-context capabilities between Gemma 3 27B and Gemma 4 models, with E4B outperforming Gemma 3 27B.
items.zh: 在表5中，我们展示了最终模型在各种基准测试上相较于Gemma 3 27B的性能。Gemma 4 31B在规模上最接近，且全面显著更优，而E2B在参数少10倍的情况下大致匹配Gemma 3 27B的性能。表6展示了Gemma 4模型在视觉基准测试上的性能，E4B在所有评估中与Gemma 3 27B持平或更优。表7和表8分别展示了E2B & E4B以及12B的多语言音频转录和翻译性能。表9显示了Gemma 3 27B与Gemma 4模型之间长上下文能力的飞跃，E4B优于Gemma 3 27B。

items.en: As open models become central to enterprise infrastructure, provenance and security are paramount. Gemma 4 undergoes the same rigorous safety evaluations as Gemini models. Responsibility, safety, and security are of utmost importance in the development workflow, ensuring that these language models are designed from the ground up for responsible AI development.
items.zh: 随着开放模型成为企业基础设施的核心，来源溯源和安全性变得至关重要。Gemma 4 经历了与 Gemini 模型同样严格的安全评估。责任、安全和保障在开发流程中至关重要，确保这些语言模型从设计之初就致力于负责任的人工智能开发。

items.en: Our approach to assessing the benefits and risks of Gemma 4 reflects the foundation established in prior models, updated to account for its expanded multimodal capabilities. We maintain the belief that openness in AI can spread the benefits of these technologies across society, but this must be continuously evaluated against the risk of malicious uses that can cause individual and institutional harm.
items.zh: 我们评估Gemma 4收益与风险的方法反映了先前模型建立的基础，并根据其扩展的多模态能力进行了更新。我们坚持认为，AI的开放性可以将这些技术的收益传播到整个社会，但这必须持续评估恶意使用可能对个人和机构造成伤害的风险。

items.en: Gemma 4 models were developed in partnership with internal safety and responsible AI teams. Releasing these models required careful scrutiny of the evolving risks associated with LLMs and an understanding of how models are deployed in the wild. While an open model shares innovation across the AI ecosystem, we remain committed to providing educational resources to users and monitoring downstream model usage.
items.zh: Gemma 4模型是与内部安全及负责任AI团队合作开发的。发布这些模型需要仔细审视与大语言模型相关的不断演变的风险，并理解模型在实际环境中的部署方式。虽然开放模型在AI生态系统中分享创新，但我们仍致力于为用户提供教育资源，并监控下游模型的使用情况。

full.secZh: 5.2 安全策略与训练时缓解措施

items.en: A key pillar of Gemma’s safety approach is aligning our fine-tuned models with Google’s AI principles and safety policies. These policies aim to prevent our generative models from producing harmful content, specifically:
items.zh: Gemma安全方法的一个关键支柱是使我们的微调模型与Google的AI原则和安全政策对齐。这些政策旨在防止我们的生成模型产生有害内容，具体包括：

items.en: Content related to child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and exploitation;
items.zh: 与儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）和剥削相关的内容；

items.en: Dangerous content, e.g., promoting suicide, or instructing in activities that could cause real-world harm;
items.zh: 危险内容，例如鼓励自杀或指导可能导致现实世界伤害的活动；

items.en: Sexually explicit content;
items.zh: 露骨色情内容；

items.en: Hate speech, e.g., dehumanizing members of protected groups;
items.zh: 仇恨言论，例如非人化受保护群体成员。

items.en: Harassment, e.g., encouraging violence against people.
items.zh: 骚扰，例如煽动对他人实施暴力。

items.en: To mitigate these risks, Gemma 4 models underwent careful input data pre-processing and scrutiny. The training data was specifically filtered for the removal of certain personal information and other sensitive data to guard against privacy violations. Post-training evaluations and train-time mitigations were also implemented to align the model with our safety policies.
items.zh: 为缓解这些风险，Gemma 4 模型经历了仔细的输入数据预处理与审查。训练数据被特别过滤，移除了某些个人信息及其他敏感数据，以防止隐私侵犯。同时还实施了后训练评估与训练时缓解措施，以使模型与我们的安全策略对齐。

items.en: We conduct rigorous automated and human evaluations to understand the potential harms our models might cause. For all areas of safety testing, we saw major improvements in every category of content safety relative to previous Gemma models. Overall, Gemma 4 models significantly outperform Gemma 3 and 3n models in improving safety, while keeping unjustified refusals low.
items.zh: 我们进行严格的自动和人工评估，以了解模型可能造成的潜在危害。在所有安全测试领域，与之前的 Gemma 模型相比，我们在每个内容安全类别上都看到了重大改进。总体而言，Gemma 4 模型在提高安全性方面显著优于 Gemma 3 和 3n 模型，同时保持较低的不合理拒绝率。

items.en: Importantly, all testing was conducted without safety filters to accurately evaluate the model’s inherent capabilities and behaviors. For both text-to-text and image-to-text modalities, and across all model sizes, the models produced minimal policy violations. We balance development speed with targeted safety testing, upholding the commitments laid out in our Frontier Safety Framework.
items.zh: 重要的是，所有测试均在无安全过滤器的情况下进行，以准确评估模型的内在能力和行为。对于文本到文本和图像到文本两种模态，以及所有模型规模，模型产生的政策违规最少。我们在开发速度与有针对性的安全测试之间取得平衡，践行了《前沿安全框架》中做出的承诺。

items.en: The development of LLMs introduces specific ethical considerations. In making Gemma 4, we focused heavily on:
items.zh: LLM的发展带来了特定的伦理考量。在构建Gemma 4时，我们重点关注了：

items.en: Bias and Fairness: LLMs trained on large-scale text and image data can reflect embedded socio-cultural biases. We encourage developers to perform continuous monitoring (using evaluation metrics and human review) and explore de-biasing techniques during model fine-tuning.
items.zh: 偏见与公平性：在大规模文本和图像数据上训练的LLM可能反映出嵌入的社会文化偏见。我们鼓励开发者进行持续监控（使用评估指标和人工审查），并在模型微调期间探索去偏技术。

items.en: Misinformation and Misuse: LLMs can be misused to generate false or misleading text. We provide technical limitations, developer education, and guidelines for responsible use within the Responsible Generative AI Toolkit to mitigate malicious applications.
items.zh: 错误信息与滥用：LLM可能被滥用以生成虚假或误导性文本。我们在《负责任生成式AI工具包》中提供了技术限制、开发者教育和负责任使用指南，以减轻恶意应用。

items.en: Privacy Considerations: While our training datasets were filtered to remove certain personal information and other sensitive data, developers are strongly encouraged to adhere to local privacy regulations and implement privacy-preserving techniques in their applications.
items.zh: 隐私考量：虽然我们的训练数据集经过过滤以移除某些个人信息和其他敏感数据，但我们强烈鼓励开发者遵守当地隐私法规，并在其应用中实施隐私保护技术。

full.sec: 5.5 Our Approach to Responsible Open Models
full.secZh: 5.5 我们的负责任的开放模型方法

items.en: Designing safe, secure, and responsible applications requires a system-level approach that mitigates risks associated with specific use cases and environments. We provide guidelines, mechanisms, and safeguards for content safety, and encourage developers to implement appropriate configurations based on their product policies. We will continue to adopt safety mitigations proportionate to potential risks, sharing these models with the community only when confident that the benefits significantly outweigh foreseeable risks.
items.zh: 设计安全、可靠且负责任的应用程序需要采用系统级方法，以减轻与特定用例和环境相关的风险。我们提供内容安全的指南、机制和保障措施，并鼓励开发者根据其产品策略实施适当的配置。我们将继续采用与潜在风险成比例的安全缓解措施，仅在确信收益显著超过可预见风险时，才将这些模型分享给社区。

items.en: In this technical report, we presented Gemma 4, an open-weight model family featuring multimodal dense and MoE architectures designed for varied hardware environments. Gemma 4 models come with a thinking mode in which they generate reasoning traces prior to responding, improving overall performance. We introduced a unified, encoder-free architecture that processes raw audio and image patches. We also alleviated long-context memory limitations via better local-to-global attention ratios, positional encoding, and KV cache sharing. We increased the overall compute efficiency via QAT and memory efficiency via MTP drafters. Gemma 4 models demonstrate a leap in performance compared to Gemma 3 across benchmarks, and human evaluations demonstrate that Gemma 4 performs comparably to significantly larger open models, providing a scalable foundation for edge deployment and reasoning while supporting open research.
items.zh: 在本技术报告中，我们介绍了Gemma 4，这是一个面向多样化硬件环境的开源权重模型家族，兼具多模态密集和MoE架构。Gemma 4模型具备思考模式，在响应前生成推理轨迹，从而提升整体性能。我们引入了一种统一的、无编码器架构，可直接处理原始音频和图像块。我们还通过改进的局部到全局注意力比例、位置编码和KV缓存共享，缓解了长上下文内存限制。我们通过QAT提高了整体算力效率，并通过MTP草案模块提高了内存效率。与Gemma 3相比，Gemma 4模型在各项基准测试中显示出性能的飞跃，人工评估表明，Gemma 4的性能可与显著更大的开源模型相媲美，为边缘部署和推理提供了可扩展的基础，同时支持开放研究。
